Fever proxy (T). Video cannot read temperature, but febrile cattle in challenge studies eat less and lie still more [10-12]. C09 scores highest (+1.2: lying still, not chewing, 63 % of the time vs 46-53 % for the herd), then C08 (+0.6); take C09's temperature first. Most fevers show no visible sign [13], so this orders whom to check; it does not replace a thermometer.
